caption: the 2012 Easter edition of Ultimate Omelette - eggs fighting eggs.

req.note: same body as Ultimate Omelette: 2010-era light 3D, DirectX 8.1-class. anything modern plays it.

links.official_note: still sold on Steam (verified today); the studio's download hub carries it too.
links.anyway_note: no clean mirror verified yet - the official path is alive, so nothing is at risk.

about: Ultimate Omelette Easter Edition (11 March 2012) leans into the one holiday the series was born to parody: a war against egg-laying invaders, celebrated with eggs. The full fourth-episode campaign runs in spring dressing, from the opening waves to the Egg Cannon itself.

By 2012 the edition line was a machine - Christmas, Easter and eventually Thanksgiving variants of the same engine, each with its own dressing and wave twists - and this is the middle child of the Ultimate Omelette trio. Like its siblings it shipped from the studio's own distribution, never Steam, so the official download hub remains the legitimate source.
It completes the Ultimate Omelette set on this archive's shelf: standard, Christmas, Easter, Thanksgiving - four builds of the fourth war, all playable on hardware far below the target bar.
notes_extra: original release 2012-03-11; Steam never carried this edition.
